integrity: Each finite certificate is reconstructed from the labelled cyclic graph and complete face posets by the bundled standard-library Python script. The recorded stdout is separately included and can be exactly reproduced.
scientific_limitations: The theorem only concerns cubic powers of cycles with 13, 14, or 15 vertices and bounded independence parameter 3.
The exhaustive matching certificate is finite; it supplies no recurrence or global classification for other parameters.
The integral homotopy classification uses Forman discrete Morse theory, combinatorial Alexander duality and simple connectivity; the mod-two calculation is solely corroborative.
Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: The three missing cubic-cycle total three-cut homotopy types
